lastCommit.message:
OTA-1814 — the report screen joins the trace

OBSERVATIONAL TELEMETRY ONLY.
GAMEPLAY FREEZE REPAIR ATTEMPTED: NO.
REPORT FREEZE REPAIR ATTEMPTED: NO.
Neither freeze is fixed; neither cause is known.

WHAT THE HEALTHY APPLE CONTROL EXPOSED. Robert Schmobert's OTA-1813 run on a 2022
iPhone SE (bundle mu096euu9i87, 8/8 parts, 56,188 chars) proved the instrument
works: four interactions, zero orphans, T0→T1 in 0–1ms, logUiTap and T2 stamped
in the same millisecond, and a stamina refusal whose `reject` matched the store's
own line one millisecond later. It also showed where the instrument was BLIND,
and the blind spot was exactly where the OTHER freeze lives — AboutScreen carried
ZERO touch-path coverage, so the post-report freeze that reproduced 2/2 on Build
189 would have left no trace of any kind.

FOUR SEAMS, EACH ANSWERING A QUESTION NOTHING ELSE COULD:

  T0 on AboutScreen        Did a touch reach the report screen at all? Nothing
                           observed this surface before.

  M0 on the composer card  PROVEN NECESSARY, not assumed. KeyboardSafeCard
                           renders a native <Modal>, so its content is hosted
                           OUTSIDE AboutScreen's tree and T0 structurally cannot
                           see it — the same RN mechanism already proven for
                           SearchModal / GatherModal / ClimbModal. OPT-IN via one
                           optional prop: five modals share that card and only
                           the report composer passes it, so the other four
                           render byte-identically to 1813.

  T1/T2 on SEND and CANCEL Did the control receive the press, and did its handler
                           run? Every control on the report path was
                           uninstrumented, which made a bare T0 there always the
                           useless reading.

  admit/reject + pres      Did the async send RESOLVE, and did the receipt get
                           REQUESTED and then actually SHOWN?

`pres` IS THE ONE NEW WORD, and it is one rather than four because the phase
rides the existing bounded `reason` field: requested / shown / dismiss / dismissed.
`requested` without `shown` means React never committed the receipt; `shown`
without `dismissed` means it committed and the way out never completed. Different
faults, different repairs, and no stage in 1813 could separate them.

THE ID IS HELD ACROSS THE AWAIT. `currentTouchId` is age-bounded at 1.5s and the
send can take seconds, so the interaction id is captured at dispatch into a REF —
not state, nothing here may cause a render — and reused for the resolution and
every receipt stage. One physical tap stays ONE interaction id from press to
dismissal, which is what makes the trace readable as a single story.

THE SENT REPORT STILL CANNOT DESCRIBE ITS OWN AFTERMATH, and this OTA does not
pretend otherwise. The payload is composed before the receipt exists, so every
stage from `admit` onward reaches a reader on the NEXT boot under `prior boot:`.
The existing persistence already carries them — one write in flight, leading plus
one coalesced trailing — so NOTHING about persistence was changed or redesigned.

THE RECEIPT'S OK TAP NEEDED NO EDIT, because OTA-1812 made that receipt INLINE:
it renders inside AboutScreen's own tree, so the new root observer sees the tap.
Had it stayed a native <Modal> it would not. That is a real consequence of 1812,
and it is why no separate dismiss-requested stage was minted — `root` with no
`dismissed` already carries the meaning, and OTA-1812's pinned element is
untouched.

A REFUSAL IS STILL ONLY WRITTEN WHERE SOURCE PROVES ONE. The composer's `canSend`
guard is NOT recorded: the SEND key is `disabled` in that state, so RN never runs
the handler and the branch is defensive and unreachable. The recorded rejections
are the report's OWN returned statuses — unchanged / off / unconfigured / failed —
data the composer hands back rather than a verdict invented here.

UNEXERCISED IS NOT BROKEN. Robert's session never opened Search/Gather/Climb and
never took a deferred submit, so M0 and armed/fired have no device evidence yet.
Source coverage for all three sheets was re-read at HEAD, found correct, and left
exactly as it was. Nothing was changed merely because one session did not use it.

OBSERVER EFFECT. Root observers return false and claim no responder; no gameplay
state is mutated; no action is serialised, debounced, or re-admitted; no modal
dismissal, ML ownership or navigation behaviour changes; no per-stage awaited
storage write; no recurring timer; no new React or Zustand render pressure — the
one effect added rides a commit that already happens. Ring and fields stay
bounded.

VERIFICATION. 22/22 check gates green. typecheck:ci clean; typecheck:tests at
baseline 201 (NOT raised); lint clean. New suite ota1814TheReportScreenJoinsTheTrace
32/32 over ten sections. Four negative controls each went red on a reversed
production condition and green again — the About root observer claiming the
responder, the composer's M0 removed, `shown` collapsed into `requested`, and a
fabricated rejection on the unreachable canSend guard — and none remains in the
tree. Full fast surface 1358/1358 suites, 14,393 tests, re-run on this exact tree.

WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED. No test here can present a native iOS modal or reproduce
either freeze. This OTA only makes the next reproduction legible; the answer
still requires a device.
